assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:aisha@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Aisha bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.3) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V15, with direct Aisha grounds in the V10 retrospective family and travel evidence, V11, V12, V13 and V15. The model routes its observations to an evidence index, shared state ledger sections, a V11 checkpoint, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses, none of which is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only. No web novel, later light-novel volume, adaptation, performed voice, reception or remembered franchise biography is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's ten selectors MT-AM-ST01 to ST10: the V10 retrospective family hierarchy and rapid travel plan (ST01); V11 the schooling bargain, test and dorm fairness dispute (ST02), household routine, wages, gardening and decoration (ST03) and pregnancy and expedition preparations with her home role (ST04); V12 household reception and the reunion with her mother under shared grief (ST05) and family criticism and childbirth assistance (ST06); V13 garden expertise and contested privacy (ST07) and recognition, a shared birthday and cooperation around Lucy (ST08); and V15 a small crop with her stated need for her brother rather than a substitute (ST09) and initiated hospitality for Eris with practical household costs (ST10). No selector covers V14. She is a dependent child whose relative age and trained capacity do not remove that dependency; ST01 receives no later household permissions, no earlier state acquires later knowledge, and nothing after V15 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives five conditional rules (MT-AM-001 to 005): concrete objectives advanced through information, effort and adult permission or protection; negotiable conditions met through leverage, mirrored register and bargaining; differential treatment activating a learned inferior birth rank and comparison with Norn; household needs met with practiced service while personal wants are pressed against the role; and role-aware switching between formality, teasing and complaint. Each has a countercase and a discriminating test, and the explanatory section constrains competence by the labor behind it, separates a present preference for service from equal alternatives, and refuses a general hidden-manipulation theory. B is not supported because the model records no new negotiable bargain for rule 002 in V12 or V15, no fresh birth-ranking confrontation for rule 003 in V15, moderate mechanism confidence and retrospective checks only. Falsifiable rules with countercases exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Ten selectors run from the V10 retrospective (ST01) to V15 (ST10) with a stated change kind for the V11 states (KNOWLEDGE/RELATIONSHIP, PRACTICE, CONTEXT) and leakage bars: ST01 gets no later household permissions, Rudeus initially lacks her knowledge of her effort and learned ranking, and no earlier state acquires later knowledge. The model also tracks narrow change: reduced belittling is not a transformed sibling relationship (V11), recognition through matching gifts is local inclusion (V13:022), and taught rescue debt becomes her own hospitality (V15:020). B is not supported because the selectors are one-line cells, ST05-ST10 cite ledger sections (S192, S206, S247) rather than locators in the selector table, and no state covers V14; a reviewer may weigh that as D. A sequence with per-state limits exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D was not chosen.

The model characterizes her written speech only in prose: polished service formality, teasing familiarity, direct bargaining and distressed fairness protest, chosen by listener and task rather than a single verbal tic, with one documented tactic (mirroring formal speech to change her brother's register, V11:001) and situational variation extended in V12, V13 and V15 (V12:027/031/033, V13:010/020-022, V15:016/018/020/027/033). It quotes no wording or self-reference, excludes acoustic delivery, and retains her sexualized remarks only as non-graphic evidence of learned role language that is not to be reproduced. Prose-only register description does not support D; the register is affirmatively differentiated, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

Ordinary work is her best-supported domain: the model has two rules that bear directly on it (001 practical competence with labor and support, 004 practiced household service with personal wants) and an explanatory paragraph on cleaning and household management, negotiated pay, gardening and decorative objects as leisure, and practical organization on pregnancy news, extended with locators in each later volume: hospitality before the reunion and coached birth assistance (V12:027/033), garden and fishing success (V13:010/021), a limited rice harvest with soil and recipe support and hospitality for Eris (V15:017/020/027). This is more than the clause-level items that put other Mushoku Tensei subjects at D. B is not supported because the cells are compressed, leisure beyond gardening, decoration and named requests is unestablished, calibration is retrospective and V14 is uncovered; a reviewer may weigh it as D. Rule-level treatment across four volumes exceeds distributed mentions, so D was not chosen.

Rule 005 and the explanatory section make listener and task required inputs, and the model locates differentiated responses: Rudeus as the brother she bargains with, mirrors and is misread by (V11:001/003/012, V12:027) and whose own answer she wants rather than a substitute (V15:018); Norn as the sibling she is compared with, belittles, rebukes and teases (V11:003/009, V12:031, V15:016); Lilia as the source of role instruction, rescue-debt teaching and coached birth assistance, and as the mother she reunites with (V10:024, V12:027/033, V15:020); household patrons invoked to negotiate decorations; Ruijerd as escort (V10); cooperation around Lucy after rivalry (V13:028); and Eris, whom she welcomes on her own initiative (V15:020). B is not supported because the later responses are clauses and several are qualified as local agreement rather than repair; differentiated responses across several attested recipients exceed a single relational sketch, so D is not supported.

The model states that her emotion is less accessible than her visible performance and that access depends on Rudeus's observation and her dialogue more than Norn's first-person chapter; it treats outside appraisal as not inner fact (V12:027, Rudeus retracting a resentment inference) and lists broader private interiority as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Located disclosures remain: hurt at being ranked below Norn, insecurity, anxiety at departure (V11:003/020), restrained joy at the reunion (V12:027) and a stated wish for her brother himself (V15:018). C is not supported because there is no rendered inner sequence and the model withholds it; repeated disclosed feeling across four volumes exceeds a single attributed motive, so E is not supported.

Two rules govern conflict-bearing triggers with countercases: rule 003 for differential treatment (the dorm fairness protest with partial acceptance of explanation, V11:003; continued belittling despite her own injury; a cutting rebuke of Norn's statement implying Lilia's illegitimacy, V12:031) and rule 002 for leverage in a dispute (secret-shrine leverage and negotiated conditions over the plant, V13:010, retained as a coercive tactic without making earlier warmth calculated). Located complaints add practical objections about household costs (V15:027/033) and criticism of brother and sister (V12:031). B is not supported because V15 supplies no fresh rank confrontation, rule 002 has no V12 or V15 analog and mechanism confidence is moderate; rule-level conflict treatment with countercases exceeds located disputes alone, so D is not supported.

The model locates morally weighted positions: a sense of fairness that distinguishes reasoned comparison of conditions from being ranked by birth (V11:003), declining excess pay under an idea of appropriate treatment (V11:012), rebuking a statement that impugns her mother (V12:031), turning taught rescue debt into hospitality (V15:020) and the retained coercion of the plant dispute (V13:010). These are positions with attributed reasons, not shown weighing, so C is not supported; repeated located positions across four volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model calls her social strategy often concrete and playful and names teasing familiarity among her registers, and locates teasing among the V13 requests and birthday exchanges (V13:020-022) and sibling teasing in V15 (V15:016). It gives no content, pattern or rule for humor, so D is not supported; located teasing in three volumes is affirmative evidence, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

One curated item: a compact model (revision 1.3) covering the V10 retrospective and V11-V13 and V15 through five rules, ten selectors and sixteen retrospective checks, with observations routed to an evidence index, shared ledger sections, a V11 checkpoint, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses that are not curated on her row. The model declares itself BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with no clean holdout, defers a monograph, names broader private interiority, adult relationships, unfamiliar leadership, independent employment and complete sibling repair as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and has no V14 selector, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of the volumes in which she is a direct subject exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative limits and countercases: exhaustion after the overnight travel plan, first misread as laziness (V10:024), a failed chantless transfer beside the met exam condition (V11:001/003), explicit instruction to seek experienced adults during Rudeus's absence and anxiety (V11:020), birth assistance under Lilia's guidance rather than independent competence (V12:033), continued belittling of Norn and a cutting rebuke (V12:031), coercive leverage over the plant (V13:010), refusal of excess pay against a maximizing model (V11:012) and a harvest limited by seed and soil (V15:017). Each limit is a clause and calibration is retrospective with disclosed prior familiarity, so B is not supported; located failures and countercases across four volumes exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume, the V10 and V11 selectors to locators, and the model keeps audience ceilings (Rudeus initially lacks her knowledge of the labor and ranking behind her behavior; his reading of her restraint is not inner fact) and bars giving ST01 later permissions. B is not supported because the selectors are one-line labels, the V12-V15 selectors carry ledger sections rather than locators, no age is computed and V14 has no state; D is not supported because knowledge is bounded per state rather than given as a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: The model characterizes her register only in prose, quotes no wording, excludes acoustic delivery and bars reproducing her sexualized role language. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a prose register description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized register.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-AM-ST01 to ST10 between the V10 retrospective and V15, with that state's knowledge only; no V14 state, nothing after V15, no computed age and no later permissions or knowledge in an earlier state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Rudeus as brother and household head, Norn as compared sibling, Lilia as mother and role instructor, Ruijerd as escort, household patrons, the household around Lucy, Eris as welcomed household member and Nana as the substitute provider she declines.
setting_constraints: The travel, school, dormitory, household, garden and hospitality settings of the Japanese light novels V10-V13 and V15
Dependent child with adult backup; no independent adult employment, business, leadership, political strategy or medical authority
No romance, no sexualized scenario and no reproduction of sexualized role language
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits D0 represented behavior and only D1 near-analog extension within named work and family contexts, keeps all admitted domains BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL, requires abstention in unsupported contexts and lists broader interiority, adult relationships, unfamiliar leadership, independent employment and complete sibling repair as insufficient evidence; it explicitly does not model an independent adult behind a child's appearance, and calibration is retrospective. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

conditions: Only household work, wage and leisure requests, gardening and hospitality, fairness complaints and role-aware requests in attested household, school and garden settings, as near analogs.
Competence requires labor, information and adult support or permission; no effortless or universal mastery and no completed achievement is generated.
She remains a dependent child: service is not free adult employment and she does not substitute for a parent or household head.
Requests and bargains are not presumed to be concealed plans, and local agreement or recognition is not repair of sibling rivalry or rank.
The selected state's knowledge only; output is behavior described in prose, no sexualized role language is reproduced and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: Rules 001, 004 and 005 are extended in every later volume, and the model names familiar household planning, role bargaining, fairness protest and stated leisure as its BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL domains: household routine, wages, gardening and decoration (V11:004/012-014), hospitality and coached birth assistance (V12:027/033), garden, fishing, recognition and Lucy cooperation (V13:010/020-022/028) and the crop, personal requests, hospitality and household complaints (V15:016-020/027/033). Readiness is conditional because the cells are compressed, leisure beyond the named items is unknown and the checks are retrospective. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a social model; NOT_READY would deny the household and bargaining behavior the model extends across four volumes.

The evidence locates positions with attributed reasons (fairness against birth ranking, appropriate pay, the rebuke defending her mother, taught debt as hospitality, coercive leverage), but no rendered weighing between competing goods. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the model does not show; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located positions.

No romantic relationship of hers is in evidence; the model excludes adult romance and keeps her sexualized remarks only as learned role language that is not reproduced or used for invented scenarios. Absence of evidence establishes neither readiness nor incapacity.

Her work is household service within the family, which the model says is not independent adult employment; independent employment, unrestricted business aptitude and unfamiliar leadership are listed as unsupported or insufficient, and Rudeus's instruction to seek experienced adults caps treating her as an autonomous substitute (V11:020). CONDITIONAL would relabel household service as a professional domain; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located wage negotiation and the model's explicit ceiling.

known_limits.statement: Her fast planning and skilled work are revealed as labor and depend on information, rest, guidance and adult protection; she is not an effortless all-domain prodigy.

She is a dependent child whose relative age and trained capacity do not remove the need for care; Rudeus's instruction to seek experienced adults caps treating her as a substitute parent or household head.
Her preference for service is real but shaped by Lilia's instruction and a learned inferior birth rank; it does not show that alternatives were equally open or that she is freely employed.

Her bargaining, mirrored register and leverage are concrete tactics toward named aims; they do not establish a general concealed-manipulation theory, and the coercive plant leverage does not make earlier warmth calculated.
She declines excessive pay and bargains within a relationship and an idea of appropriate treatment, not for every available gain.
She is hurt by birth ranking and also belittles Norn; her injury does not make her innocent, and the cruelty does not make family affection false.
Equal-sister assurance, matching gifts and cooperation around Lucy are local inclusion; hierarchy, grief and sibling rivalry are not erased.
Cheerful performance and Rudeus's readings of her restraint do not give access to her feelings; competence and cheer are not the absence of mourning or need.
Her sexualized remarks are retained only as non-graphic evidence of learned role language; they are not reproduced, and no romance or sexualized scenario is modeled.

All sixteen checks are retrospective fits with disclosed prior franchise familiarity, not clean holdouts or numerical prediction scores; scene confidence is high and mechanism confidence moderate, and no domain is DOMAIN_READY.
The model records no new negotiable bargain for rule 002 in V12 or V15 and no fresh birth-ranking confrontation for rule 003 in V15; later applicability of those rules rests on fewer tests.

The evidence index, shared ledger sections, V11 checkpoint, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses to which the model routes its observations are not curated on this subject, so its locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

Broader private interiority, adult relationships, unfamiliar leadership, independent employment, business aptitude, political strategy, clinical interpretation and leisure beyond the named items are not established; this is a gap, not evidence of incapacity.
No wording, self-reference or acoustic performance is in evidence; register is described only in prose.
Direct grounds begin with the V10 retrospective, no state covers V14 and nothing after V15 is in evidence; earlier and later states, knowledge and outcomes are not assessed.
